title: 第十三章 钦差大臣第十四章 难民区的新人
content_zh:
卯时三刻，天光微亮。
柳花巷的石板路上还残留着昨夜的湿气，几个宿醉的客人歪歪斜斜从春香楼侧门出来，被清晨的冷风一吹，扶着墙根吐了一地。
何成局从巷子东头走过来，穿一件半旧的青色长衫，腰间系着一条黑色布带，脚上蹬着千层底布鞋。他走得不快不慢，经过那几个醉汉时连看都没看一眼，径直推开春香楼的侧门。
门内，几个杂役正在洒扫。
“二爷。”一个瘸腿的老头拄着扫帚让开路，脸上堆着笑。
“老刘，昨儿腿疼没犯吧？”何成局停下脚步，从袖子里摸出一个纸包递过去，“茯苓堂买的狗皮膏药，听说好用，你试试。”
瘸腿老刘愣了愣，双手接过：“二爷您这记性也太好了，我就随口提过一句……”
“少废话，干活去。”何成局摆摆手，穿过大堂。
大堂里杯盘狼藉，空气中混杂着酒气、脂粉香和一股说不清道不明的暧昧味道。柜台后面，账房先生龚文已经坐在那里了。他今年五十八，瘦得跟竹竿似的，戴一副老花镜，算盘珠子拨得噼里啪啦响。
“二爷，早。”龚文头也不抬，全凭脚步声认人。
“早。”何成局在柜台边站定，自己动手从茶壶里倒了杯茶——照例是最便宜的粗茶，喝一口苦得舌根发麻。他皱眉，“老龚，你就不能换点能入口的茶叶？”
“能入口的茶叶要钱。”龚文推了推眼镜，终于抬起头来，“昨晚上进账三十七两六钱，其中苏筱接了布庄王少东家，十两；林函只接了一个客人，五两；张颜三个散客，加起来八两；彭幼楚喝醉了在二楼唱曲，多卖了十四两六钱的酒菜。”
“幼楚这丫头，一喝酒就变人。”何成局笑了一声，“让她少喝点，醉酒伤身。”
“劝过，没用。”龚文面无表情，“三娘骂也骂了，打也打了，她就是改不了。”
何成局没接话，目光在空荡荡的大堂里扫了一圈。他今年十九岁，长了一张谁都欠我一万两的脸——眉毛不浓不淡，眼睛不大不小，嘴角常年微微上翘，看起来就像个脾气暴躁的恶霸。但柳花巷里的人都知道，春香楼的何二爷，笑起来比不笑更吓人。
楼梯上传来脚步声。
余三娘走下来。她今年四十五，穿一件暗红色的褙子，头发梳得一丝不苟，整个人干净利落。她在楼梯中间停了一下，看向何成局的目光平淡得很，就像掌柜的看账房，东家看管事。
“二当家来了。”她说，语气里没有多余的温度。
“嗯。”何成局点点头，也没客套，“昨晚上斧头帮的人来，什么时候走的？”
“亥时末。”余三娘走到柜台前，从袖子里抽出一张叠得整整齐齐的纸，“三个人，领头的姓赵，络腮胡，左眉角有颗黑痣。说给三天时间凑五十两，不然砸招牌。”

何成局接过纸打开看了一眼。上面用工整的小楷写着——斧头帮赵姓头目，年约三十，身高五尺二寸，络腮胡，左眉角黑痣，带二人，一瘦一胖。亥时初至，亥时末去。出门后往西，进了牛头巷的聚义茶馆。
“三娘办事就是利索。”何成局把纸收进袖子里。
“分内事。”余三娘倒了一杯茶，“五十两银子，你打算怎么着？”
“给。”
余三娘端着茶杯的手顿了一下。
何成局笑了，那笑容温和极了：“人家是斧头帮，好几百号人，咱们开青楼的拿什么跟人硬碰？和气生财，五十两买个平安，不亏。”
余三娘看了他一眼，什么也没说，低头喝茶。
共事六年，她太了解何成局了。这男人嘴上说“和气生财”的时候，往往有人要倒霉。
“不过，”何成局话锋一转，还是那副笑眯眯的表情，“总得先摸清楚底细。住哪儿，几个人当值，晚上爱去哪儿喝酒。刘二的腿最近还行？”
“老毛病了，盯个梢没问题。”余三娘放下茶杯，“我让他去跟了。”
“好。”何成局也不多说，起身往厨房方向走，“让厨房下碗面，多放辣子，再卧个荷包蛋。”
“大清早吃这么荤。”
余三娘没再说话，何成局也没回头。两个人之间的关系就是如此——她是鸨母，他是二当家。她管姑娘们和日常经营，他管外面的事和不能见光的事，从不出错。
厨房里热气腾腾，胖厨娘王婶正在揉面，见何成局进来，擦擦手就要行礼。何成局摆摆手，在灶台边的长凳上坐下。
“二爷，面马上就好。”王婶手脚麻利地擀面切面。
何成局坐在那里，眼睛望着灶膛里的火苗，脑子里转着斧头帮的事。
斧头帮是广州城的地头蛇，帮主叫雷虎，据说是个武者六阶的高手，手底下好几百号亡命徒，收保护费、开赌场、放高利贷，什么都干。柳花巷这一片本来不在他们的地盘范围内，最近却把手伸过来，说明雷虎在扩张。
一个春香楼倒没什么，五十两银子给就给了。但问题在于，今天给五十两，下个月他就会要一百两。胃口是喂出来的。
得想个一劳永逸的法子。
“二爷，面好了。”王婶端上来一大碗阳春面，汤底清亮，面条根根分明，上面卧着一个荷包蛋，旁边厚厚铺了一层红艳艳的辣椒油。

何成局夹起一筷子面，呼噜噜吃了一口，辣得直吸气：“王婶你这辣椒是哪儿买的？够劲。”
“老家带来的朝天椒，自家晒的。”王婶笑得眼睛眯成一条缝。
何成局一边吃面一边问：“王婶，你家小子最近怎么样？”
“托二爷的福，在码头找了个扛包的活，一天能挣三十文呢。”王婶提起儿子就眉开眼笑，“要不是二爷给陈老板打了招呼——”
“小事。”何成局打断她，低头吃面。
content_en:
At three o'clock in the morning, the sky was slightly bright.
The moisture from last night still lingered on the stone pavement of Liuhua Lane. A few hungover guests staggered out of the side door of Chunxiang Building. They were blown by the cold morning wind and vomited all over the floor while holding on to the wall.
He Chengju walked over from the east end of the alley, wearing a half-worn blue gown, a black cloth belt around his waist, and mille-layer cloth shoes on his feet. He walked neither fast nor slowly. He didn't even look at the drunk men when he passed them, and he pushed open the side door of Chunxiang Building.
Inside the door, several handymen were sweeping.
"Second Master." A lame old man stepped out of the way with a broom and a smile on his face.
"Old Liu, your leg hurt yesterday, did you?" He Chengju stopped, took out a paper bag from his sleeve and handed it over, "The dog skin plaster I bought from Fulingtang, I heard it is effective, you can try it."
The lame old Liu was stunned for a moment, then took it with both hands: "Second Master, you have a very good memory, so I just mentioned it casually..."
"Stop talking nonsense and get to work." He Chengju waved his hand and walked through the lobby.
Cups and plates were in a mess in the lobby, and the air was mixed with the smell of alcohol, powder, and an unexplainable ambiguous smell. Behind the counter, Mr. Gong Wen, the accountant, was already sitting there. He is fifty-eight years old, as thin as a bamboo pole, wears a pair of reading glasses, and the beads on his abacus make a snapping sound.
"Good morning, Second Master." Gong Wen didn't even raise his head, recognizing people solely by their footsteps.
"Morning." He Chengju stood at the counter and poured a cup of tea from the teapot - as usual, it was the cheapest coarse tea. One sip was so bitter that the root of the tongue was numb. He frowned, "Old Gong, can't you change to some tea that can be eaten?"
"Tea that can be imported costs money." Gong Wen pushed up his glasses and finally raised his head, "I received thirty-seven taels and six taels last night, of which Su Xiao took over Wang Shaodong's house in Buzhuang, 10 taels; Lin Han only received one guest, five taels; Zhang Yan had three individual guests, totaling eight taels; Peng Youchu got drunk and sang on the second floor, and sold more food and drinks for fourteen taels."
"Youchu, this girl, changes into a different person when she drinks." He Chengju laughed, "Let her drink less, drunkenness will harm her body."
"I tried to persuade her, but it was useless." Gong Wen said expressionlessly, "Sanniang scolded and beat her, but she just can't change."
He Chengju didn't answer, his eyes swept around the empty lobby. He is nineteen years old and has a face that everyone owes me ten thousand taels - his eyebrows are neither thick nor light, his eyes are neither big nor small, and the corners of his mouth are always slightly upturned. He looks like a bad-tempered bully. But everyone in Liuhua Lane knows that Mr. He from Chunxiang Tower is more scary when he smiles than when he doesn't smile.
There were footsteps on the stairs.
Yu Sanniang walked down. She is forty-five years old. She wears a dark red gown, her hair is combed meticulously, and she looks neat and tidy. She stopped for a moment in the middle of the stairs and looked at He Chengju with a very calm look, just like the shopkeeper's accounting office and the boss's stewardship.
"The second boss is here," she said, without any extra warmth in her tone.
"Yeah." He Chengju nodded without being polite, "The Ax Gang came last night. When did they leave?"
"At the end of Haishi." Yu Sanniang walked to the counter and pulled out a neatly folded piece of paper from her sleeve. "There are three people. The leader's surname is Zhao. He has a beard and a mole on the corner of his left eyebrow. He said he has three days to collect fifty taels or else the sign will be destroyed."
He Chengju took the paper, opened it and took a look. It was written in neat small letters - the leader of the Ax Gang named Zhao, about thirty years old, five feet two inches tall, with a beard and a black mole on the corner of his left eyebrow. He has two people, one thin and one fat. Hai Shi arrives at the beginning and Hai Shi ends at the end. After going out, we went west and entered the Juyi Tea House in Niutou Lane.
"Sanniang does things quickly." He Chengju put the paper into his sleeve.
"It's my job." Yu Sanniang poured a cup of tea, "Fifty taels of silver, what are you going to do with it?"
"Here."
Yu Sanniang's hand holding the tea cup paused.
He Chengju smiled, and the smile was extremely gentle: "They are the Ax Gang, there are hundreds of them, weWhat do brothel owners do to confront people head-on? Harmony brings wealth. If you buy peace for fifty taels, you will not lose money. "
Yu Sanniang glanced at him, said nothing, and lowered her head to drink tea.
After working together for six years, she knows He Chengju very well. When this man says "harmony brings wealth", someone is often in trouble.
"However," He Chengju changed the topic, still smiling, "You have to find out the details first. Where you live, how many people are on duty, and where you like to go drinking at night. Are Liu Er's legs okay recently? "
"It's an old habit. It's okay to keep an eye on him. "Yu Sanniang put down the teacup, "I asked him to follow. "
"good. He Chengju didn't say much, got up and walked toward the kitchen, "Let the kitchen cook a bowl of noodles, add more spicy pepper, and cook a poached egg." "
“Eating such meat so early in the morning. "
Yu Sanniang said nothing, and He Chengju didn't look back. This is the relationship between two people - she is the madam and he is the second in charge. She takes care of the girls and day-to-day operations, while he takes care of external matters and things that cannot be seen in the light, and never makes mistakes.
The kitchen was steaming, and the fat cook Aunt Wang was kneading dough. When He Chengju came in, she wiped her hands and saluted. He Chengju waved his hand and sat down on the bench next to the stove.
"Second Master, the noodles will be ready soon. "Aunt Wang rolled out and cut the noodles quickly with her hands and feet.
He Chengju sat there, staring at the flames in the stove, thinking about the Ax Gang.
The Ax Gang is a local gangster in Guangzhou City. The leader of the gang is called Lei Hu. It is said that he is a master of the sixth level of martial arts. He has hundreds of desperadoes under his command. They collect protection fees, open casinos, and make loan sharks. They do everything. The area of Liuhua Lane was originally not within their territory, but recently they reached out, indicating that Leihu was expanding.
A Chunxiang Tower is nothing, just fifty taels of silver. But the problem is that if you give him fifty taels today, he will ask for a hundred taels next month. Appetite is fed.
We have to think of a permanent solution.
"Second Master, the noodles are ready. "Aunt Wang brought up a large bowl of Yangchun noodles. The soup base was clear and the noodles were clearly defined. There was a poached egg lying on it, and a thick layer of red chili oil was spread next to it.
He Chengju picked up a piece of noodles with chopsticks and Hululu took a bite, inhaling from the spicy taste: "Aunt Wang, where did you buy this chili? strong enough. "
“The Chaotian peppers brought from my hometown are dried at home. "Aunt Wang smiled so hard that her eyes narrowed into slits.
While eating noodles, He Chengju asked: "Aunt Wang, how is your boy doing lately? "
"Thanks to my second master, I found a job carrying bags at the dock, and I can earn thirty cash a day. "Aunt Wang beamed when she mentioned her son, "If the second master hadn't said hello to Boss Chen——"
"Little things. "He Chengju interrupted her and lowered his head to eat noodles.
